correctness.rationale: The positive radical solves the semiaxis quadratic. A direct identity shows every transformed unit-sphere point satisfies both ball inequalities and contacts occur exactly at |u_1|=1/sqrt(d). The 4(d-1) contacts have common supporting hyperplanes and positive weights d/(4(d-1)) whose first and second moments equal zero and I_d, giving global unique John optimality. Fixed-c limits follow from the same quadratic. Finite scipy/numpy diagnostics corroborate but do not replace these identities.
